Workflow: Classical graph preprocessing -> QUBO mapping -> Q-CTRL Optimization Solver Qiskit Function
Remarks: Optimal solution found during 16 iterations with 8192 shots. Classical graph preprocessing is applied: well-known techniques remove low-degree vertices, and vertices dominated by a neighbour, before default application of our production solver. CPU runtime includes optimised layout selection, depth reduction and other error suppression techniques from Q-CTRL Fire Opal. These techniques can be computationally intensive for large circuits, but are critical to extract quantum signal. Solver also available via Qiskit https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/docs/en/guides/q-ctrl-optimization-solver
